name: digital-control
description: Digital Control: venta y reparación de controles remotos. React + Bootstrap + Node.js/Express, sin base de datos.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.render-build: npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server install
